description: Three unchanged original emulator IPC listener-cleanup cases with the original dependency mocks; not ownership/security or real-stream acceptance.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Use original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24, no installation or reference-tree writes.

Minimal node config omits original renderer aliases, DOM/host-port setup, feature-wall define, execArgv and broader includes/timeouts. This reviewed closure exercises in-memory IPC handler functions with original hoisted dependency mocks, not a running app; no full config or typecheck equivalence claimed.
isolationRationale: Full bodies of all six staged files read. The unchanged original test mocks electron, MjpegFrameStream, scrcpyVideoRegistry and emulatorProbe before handler imports. Real EventEmitter listeners and random UUIDs are exercised; video zero-delay callbacks see removed subscriptions and return. Mock-target source files are included for resolution/provenance but their network/registry/probe implementations are not exercised. No app, emulator, network connection, child harness or real profile is started. Runner stages only under its canonical temporary fixture directory. This is not a security sandbox or real Electron test.
testEvidenceBoundary: Two frame cases assert15 explicit stop cycles and owner-destroy cleanup; one video case asserts15 explicit stop cycles. No cross-owner stop rejection, stream bytes, actual device, rendering, mixed-version transport, full registry cleanup, cross-platform run or rewritten Drogon parity. Frame stop ignores sender while video stop checks owner in source; these tests do not assert that asymmetry.
